author: Anna_M

title: Must be experienced
text: Fantastic performance. The room raised the level. To experience flamenco in a small group sitting a few meters from the dancers is the optimal. This must be experienced
author: ulfh694

title: Great flamenco
text: Very interesting setting and the acts were all very good. The singing as well. I recommend it more than the bigger venues!
author: 414madalinan

title: Intense
text:
Wow.   The dancers were intense and worked very hard.  In the intimate setting of the lower level, you sit right on top of them!  
I would love to have heard more about the history & meaning of Flamenco, before the production.  Overall highly recommended.
author: StuHCT

title: Excellent
text: Such a beautiful experience! First off, the atmosphere in the Arabian vault was an added plus. It was a smaller group of people which made it feel more personal. But the dancers and singers were AMAZING! Especially the dancers. So much emotion on their face when dancing and very skilled. I highly recommend it. Honestly, I’m so surprised that there are not more reviews. Added plus, it’s at the Flamenco Museum!
author: Zuhdiyah_D

title: Excellent flamenco show
text: The venue for this flamenco show is an atmospheric barrel-vaulted cellar, seating about 40 people in two rows very close to the performers. The singers, dancers and guitar player were all highly trained professionals who gave the audience an understanding of the true meaning of flamenco during an hour long performance which was colourful and entertaining. It was obvious that all of the participants were actually enjoying performing. An excellent show.
author: unah820

title: Authentic and amazing!
text: Intimate setting and perfect for an authentic show.   It was short and sweet and my kids loved it!!  The flamenco dancers and singers were very professional and amazing to watch.   The audience is super close to the stage so it was easy to see all the footwork and the dresses flying around.   Worth every penny!
author: 813kristig

title: Passionate flamenco at it's best ...
text:
This is presumably the home of the crème de la crème of flamenco dancing as the performers we watched look like they’ve been dancing flamenco since they were one year old! It’s not just the dancing, it’s the acting, passion and skill with their props (castanets, shawl, skirts) that combine to provide an intense performance. Couple this with the skill of the solo guitarist and the waling singers and you get a virtuoso performance.

The audience was spellbound.
author: machinmad
